notes.title: Fireball Wizard is now available for the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Dear wizard, take your seat and open your magic book, the class starts today!

Fireball Wizard is a [b]retro arcade plateformer[/b] in a pixel-art universe. You'll discover many worlds and levels, use your [b]skills [/b]to defeat impressive [b]bosses [/b]and enemies, unlock playable characters and spells along your journey in Wizardonia.

[h3]During the next days, the demo of Fireball Wizard will be [b]available [/b]on Steam![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594530/4c1b1ad6da23499b9abdba65ed804747f5f49e9d.png[/img]

Do not hesitate to give it a try and [b]wishlist [/b]the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569970/Fireball_Wizard/
